map.国际通用近似：1 kg 人体脂肪组织约含 7700 kcal 能量，故减 1 k: Common international approximation: 1 kg of human fat tissue holds about 7700 kcal, so losing 1 kg of fat needs a cumulative deficit of about 7700 kcal; this is an estimate, and real figures fluctuate with water content.

map.默认饮食 75%+运动 25% 较易坚持；运动能力强者可上调运动占比（如 50/: A default of 75% diet + 25% exercise is easier to sustain; those with strong exercise capacity can raise the exercise share (for example 50/50). Safety line: weekly weight loss of 0.5-1.0% of body weight is the recommended range, above 1.0% is fast and above 1.5% too fast (high muscle loss risk), and this tool flags it red.
